Tu potest filtrum for omnia Custom Campi a typing their names et valores. For Example: Field1 == Value1. Note: Si campi vel valores contains spaces, tu need ad encapsulate them into single quotes. For Example: 'Campus 1' == 'Valor 1'. For single control characters (' \/) ad esse skipped, tu potest use \. For example: Field1 == I\'m. Also tu potest combine multiple conditions. For Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally omnia operators sunt interpreted ex left ad right. Tu potest muta the order a placing brackets. For Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also tu potest quaere textus campi using regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

globalSearch-instructions-description: Latine: Searches potest include operators ad refine the quaere. Operators sunt specified a writing the operator nomen et valor separated a a colon. For example, an operator specification de `index:Obstructum` esset limit the quaere ad schedae illud sunt contained in a index named *Obstructum*. Si the valor contains spaces vel special characters it debet esse enclosed in quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"Ad Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: Latine: `__operator_board__:<title>` - schedae in tabulae matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: Latine: `__operator_list__:<title>` - schedae in indices matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: Latine: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - schedae in swimlanes matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: Latine: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - schedae cum a commentarium containing *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: Latine: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - schedae illud have a titulus matching *<color>* vel *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: Latine: `__operator_user__:<username>` - schedae ubi *<username>* est a *sodalis* vel *assignee*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: Latine: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - schedae ubi *<username>* est the card's creator
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: Latine: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - schedae belonging ad a tabula assigned ad organizatio *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: Latine: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - schedae belonging ad a tabula assigned ad manus *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: Latine: `__operator_due__:<n>` - cards which are due up to *<n>* days from now.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ indices omnia schedae past their dies debitus.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: Latine: `__operator_created__:<n>` - schedae which erant creatum *<n>* ante dies vel minus
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: Latine: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - schedae which erant modified *<n>* ante dies vel minus
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: Latine: `__operator_status__:<status>` - ubi *<status>* est one de the following:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: Latine: `__predicate_all__` - omnia in archivum relatum et unarchived schedae
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: Latine: `__predicate_ended__` - schedae cum an dies finis

globalSearch-instructions-status-private: Latine: `__predicate_private__` - schedae tantum in privatum tabulae
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: Latine: `__operator_has__:<field>` - where *<field>* is one of `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` or `__predicate_member__`. Placing a `-` in front de *<field>* searches for the absence de a valor in illud campus (e.g. `has:-due` searches for schedae sine a dies debitus).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: Latine: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* is one of `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` or `__predicate_modified__`. For a descending ordina, place a `-` in front de the ordina nomen.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: Latine: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - ubi *<n>* est a positive integer expressing the numerus de schedae ad esse displayed per paginam.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Latine: Multiple operators potest esse specified.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Latine: Similar operators sunt *Vel*ed together. Schedae illud match ullum de the conditions erit esse returned.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Obstructum` esset return schedae contained in ullum index named *Obstructum* vel *Praesto*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Latine: Differing operators sunt *Et*ed together. Tantum schedae illud match omnia de the differing operators sunt returned. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` returns tantum schedae in the index *Praesto* cum a *red* titulus.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Latine: Dies potest esse specified as a positive vel negative integer vel using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` or `__predicate_year__` for the praesens period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Latine: Textus searches sunt case insensitive.

After it finishes, point MONGO_URL at the aliud repositorio datorum et restart WeKan (adest Snap: snap set wekan repositorio datorum=ferretdb vel =mongodb).

Hoc shows whether illud migration succeeded et quomodo much discus space the old raw MongoDB repositorio datorum fasciculi still use inside the grain, et lets tu dele illa raw fasciculi ad free space.

There est nothing ad configure. Operators potest still force a modus cum the CARDS_LOADING (omnia/lazy/auto) et CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Latine: Lazy scheda loading est experimental: scheda counters et WIP limits sunt accurate, but the Calendar/Table/Gantt views et multi-select reflect tantum the schedae loaded so far. Reload aperi tabulae after changing hoc.

Hoc prevents misleading clickable links. Praedefinitum est abest, so links stay clickable.

Hoc reveals hidden content — HTML commentaria (<!-- -->), the target de markdown links, JavaScript et ullum aliud code — so omnia code est semper visible, non clickable, et non currens. Praedefinitum est abest, so markdown est rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, omnia importa features sunt turned abest: importing a tabula ex WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea et Forgejo, as well as cloning a tabula. The importa tabula optionum optiones sunt hidden et the ministrator rejects ullum importa request. Praedefinitum est abest.
disable-all-export-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, omnia exporta features sunt turned abest: exporting a tabula as WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, vel ad NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, et single-attachment exporta. The exporta tabula optionum optiones sunt hidden et the ministrator rejects ullum exporta request. Praedefinitum est abest.
disable-import-avatars-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, avatars (usor forma usoris pictures) sunt numquam importatum. Hoc covers WeKan JSON importa, Trello importa, et imago sync ex external identity providers adest introitus (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names et aliud data sunt still importatum; tantum avatars sunt skipped. Praedefinitum est abest.
disable-export-avatars-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, avatars (usor forma usoris pictures) sunt numquam included quando exporting a tabula (WeKan JSON et CSV exporta). Usernames et aliud data sunt still exported; tantum avatars sunt omitted. Praedefinitum est abest.
anonymize-import-users-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, importing a WeKan JSON tabula replaces omnis importatum user's nomen usoris, nomen plenum et initials cum counter placeholders (user1, user2,...), drops their imago, et rewrites @nomen usoris mentions (et the requested-by / assigned-by campi) inside importatum scheda et commentarium content. Non real usor identity ex the fons tabula est stored. The word "usor" follows the lingua de the person importing. Praedefinitum est abest.
anonymize-export-users-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, exporting a tabula replaces omnis exported user's nomen usoris, nomen plenum et initials cum counter placeholders (user1, user2,...), drops their imago, et rewrites @nomen usoris mentions (et the requested-by / assigned-by campi) inside scheda et commentarium content. The exported fasciculus carries non real usor identity. The word "usor" follows the lingua de the person exporting. Praedefinitum est abest.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Latine: Quando habilitatum, exporting a tabula replaces omnis exported user's nomen usoris, nomen plenum et initials cum counter placeholders (user1, user2,...), drops their imago, et rewrites @nomen usoris mentions (et the requested-by / assigned-by campi) inside scheda et commentarium content. disable-activities-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, activity-feed entries sunt numquam recorded et numquam shown anywhere (tabula sidebar et scheda actio tab). Non historia de quis did quid est kept. Praedefinitum est abest.
disable-notifications-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, WeKan numquam sends watch notificationes (in-app, epistula electronica vel aliud services) for ullum actio. Actiones potest still esse recorded (unless also inhabilitatum above); tantum the notificationes sunt suppressed. Praedefinitum est abest.
disable-watch-description: Latine: Quando habilitatum, the watch feature est turned abest — usores non potest subscribe ad tabulae, indices vel schedae ad receive notificationes, et ullum attempt ad muta a watch level est reiectum. Praedefinitum est abest.
backup-description: Latine: Retro up Adnexa, Avatars et/vel Data (omnia text-based collections illud sunt non adnexa vel avatars). The.zip est streamed directly ad the electum storage — non temporary fasciculus — as exemplar subsidiarium/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/exemplar subsidiarium.zip, containing YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/adnexa, /avatars et /data. Cloud storages (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) use the credentials configured in their storage tabs.
backup-scope-description: Latine: The whole instance, vel one Organizatio. An Organization's exemplar subsidiarium contains its tabulae et everything adest them, including the adnexa de illa tabulae — but non usor rationes et non instance configurationes, because illa sunt shared a omnis Organizatio. Restoring an Organization's exemplar subsidiarium tantum ever writes ad tabulae illud Organizatio owns.
